# zerops_service (Resource)

A runtime or managed Zerops service. Deployments and generated subdomain access are separate resources. Lifecycle is unmanaged unless desired_state is configured. PostgreSQL disk settings default to and must meet the provider postgresql_min_disk_gb floor (2 GB by default).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "zerops_service" "app" {
  project_id         = zerops_project.example.id
  hostname           = "app"
  type               = "nodejs@22"
  start_without_code = true
  desired_state      = "RUNNING"

  vertical_autoscaling = {
    min_cpu      = 1
    max_cpu      = 2
    min_ram_gb   = 0.25
    max_ram_gb   = 2
    swap_enabled = false
  }
  horizontal_autoscaling = {
    min_containers = 1
    max_containers = 2
  }

  timeouts {
    create = "30m"
    update = "20m"
    delete = "20m"
  }
}

# Deploying later starts the service. If desired_state is STOPPED, the next
# service apply stops it again; do not depend on graph ordering to stop a deploy.
```

## Schema

### Required

- `hostname` (String) Service hostname (1–40 lowercase alphanumeric characters).
- `project_id` (String) Parent project ID.
- `type` (String) Service type, preserving configured shorthand; base contains the canonical server spelling.

### Optional

- `desired_state` (String) RUNNING or STOPPED; omitted leaves lifecycle unmanaged. Deploying later can start a STOPPED service and produce drift.
- `env_isolation` (String) Create-only environment isolation tokens; the server validates supported modes.
- `horizontal_autoscaling` (Attributes) Custom autoscaling overrides; omitted values use server defaults. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--horizontal_autoscaling))
- `ssh_isolation` (String) Create-only SSH isolation tokens; the server validates supported modes.
- `start_without_code` (Boolean) Create-only runtime startup hint. Changing it does not deploy or start an existing service.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) Operation timeouts. One timeout covers lock acquisition, API requests, queued work and readiness polling. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `vertical_autoscaling` (Attributes) Custom autoscaling overrides; omitted values use server defaults. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vertical_autoscaling))

### Read-Only

- `base` (String) Canonical server service type.
- `created` (String) Creation timestamp in RFC3339.
- `current_autoscaling` (Attributes) Effective server autoscaling, including defaults. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--current_autoscaling))
- `id` (String) Service stack ID.
- `status` (String) Raw service status.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
terraform import zerops_service.app '<service_id>'
# Alternatively:
terraform import zerops_service.app '<project_id>/app'
# Import sets type to its canonical base and leaves desired_state unmanaged.
```
